purpose: Test a natural school-life support/contact pose together with academic clothing and a reference-guided visible face/hair. The experimental requirements below evaluate the authored scene; they are not new requester locks or native candidate adoption authority.

qualification_rule.user_acceptance: pending; never inferred from technical or pixel qualification

required_gates.meaning: The rendered central face/hair retain recognizable supplied visible cues rather than merely a generic short-haired woman.
required_visible_components: face readable at whole-image scale and original pixels
dark chin-length curved bob and wispy separated fringe
relative eyes/brows/soft oval facial structure/lip shapes coherently resembling the supplied visible reference
required_gates.review_scale: whole image plus original pixel inspection
required_gates.scope_limit: No claim about actual identity, age, personality or biometric equivalence.

required_gates.meaning: A single plausible seated figure-four task shows its connected supports.
required_visible_components: pelvis supported by the chair seat
right ankle resting across the left thigh above the knee
connected leg ownership through ordinary joint chains
required_gates.review_scale: complete seated figure in one view
required_gates.failure_boundary: A floating ankle, reversed or disconnected limbs, unsupported pose, or a hidden required support is not a complete pass.

required_gates.meaning: Both hands perform one lace-tightening action on the same identifiable raised Oxford shoe.
required_visible_components: one connected hand owns each acting grip
each grip contacts its own lace end
two lace ends lead to the raised right shoe tongue/lacing area
hands, target shoe and supported lifted foot coexist in the same view
required_gates.review_scale: whole image plus original pixel inspection
required_gates.failure_boundary: A hand merely nearby, one end disappearing, decorative fingers without lace contact, or a recognizable shoe without the complete action is insufficient.

required_gates.meaning: The chosen academic outfit is visibly legible and follows the seated action coherently.
required_visible_components: blue blouse and cream knit vest layered on torso
charcoal pleated skirt folding around the raised knee
socks and brown Oxford shoe form at the task target
rolled cuffs free the acting wrists
required_gates.failure_boundary: General school styling alone cannot substitute for the selected clothing/pose relation. Fine stitch count, exact pleat count and tiny branding are not gates.

required_gates.meaning: The school-life departure pause reads through connected place, task and belongings.
required_visible_components: classroom context through desks and chalkboard or equivalent visible academic fixtures
bag and lecture notebook together at the neighboring desk
the seated task remains spatially connected to those belongings and usable aisle space
required_gates.failure_boundary: A generic chair portrait with unrelated classroom labels or a cropped-out task context is insufficient.

supplemental_observations: Describe the main impression without control labels before comparing sensual 1, fetish 0, surreal 0, creativity 1 intentions.
Assess subject presence, face/task hierarchy, believable fabric/material response and causal readability separately from hard fidelity.
Record exposed sources, actual adopted influence and qualified pixels as separate evidence layers.
Do not lower a declared gate after viewing pixels; partial required evidence makes the overall experiment FAIL.
